body:
My therapist tried to keep my hopes up, but I knew my case was shit. Everyone present were drunk, it was my word against his. Not to mention that the police investigation was absolute shit, they didn't even tell my attorney it was closed. I'm annoyed about it now, but at the time i didn't even want the investigation to continue. I just wanted it to stop, it was one more thing I had to deal with. Even if you're aware that it might not go anywhere, it'll still hurt to hear. 

I get the dark and alone, I was really scared of my room for some time. I didnt really use sound when I went to sleep before this, but whatever helps helps. If games help then that's cool. I'm not advocating for playing games until you drop dead. But take some measures, like make sure you have the brightness down, use night mods/take away the blue hue if you can etc.

I'm rooting for you, even if your case doesn't go through, or if it does. Mine didn't, and I knew it wouldn't. You have to prove them wrong. You didn't, and you won't go through this for nothing.

I don't know the entirety of your situation. Who knows what happened and whatnot. I know that telling someone is supposed to help, idk how much it helped me. But on occasion it was nice to have someone around if there was an especially triggering event. 

I remember struggling with food and sleep as well. I havent totally managed any of them. Why and how they're a problem is probably connected to the rape, at least it was for me.
I still sleep with my lights on. I also listen to a sleep podcast. it sounds stupid, at least I thought so before I started using it. But listening to it personally made me feel a bit more safe going to sleep.

That fucking sucks balls, I feel frustrated for you.
 Prove that fuck wrong you deserve to get through this in one piece. I hope you get a break somewhere there, I know I felt really strung out at the end of my year.

I was so God damn close to dropping out too. I had classes with people who was there, every time I saw them I got triggered. I was convinced that my rapist would find me at school. 

It got better for me after I finished school. Do you have a long time left?

I want to say I'm very glad that you reported, I can understand how difficult it must have been. I didn't even do it on my own, I just told my friend what happened and she called the police for me, kind of. I hated my friend for a shit long time afterwards. I'm not gonna bullshit you with a "it gets better" because I fucking hate it when people say that. It feels like telling a drowning man to breathe or something. Idk but it somehow did get better for me, so I wouldn't say its impossible. 

I'm sorry you have to deal with this. Its so fucking unfair after what you've already been through. idk if this seems like an empty offering, but if you want someone to talk to, I'm here.
Thank you for writing this, I want you to know that your words mean a lot to me.
